g.text: SI Console Rev R5. Material: clear acrylic 3 mm (thickness ASSUMED, measure the sheet). Quantity to cut: 1.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: Kerf 0.2 mm: DXF cut paths are offset by 0.1 mm; this drawing shows nominal finished sizes. Origin = lower left of the part's bounding box.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: Mounted 20 deg from vertical, leaning back. Four 3 x 15 slots take the tabs of the two strip brackets. Control holes: green and red 30.2, kill switch 22.3, PTT and toggle 12.2, LEDs 5.2.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: Orange and 'A' = ASSUMED dimension, measure with calipers before cutting. Blue = dimension. Hole centres are X,Y from the origin.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #222222

g.text: Drawing scale about 1.10:1 on A3. Cut from the DXF, not from this sheet.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: end
